findings.resolution: Current aborted controller throws into owned failure feedback; stale attempts remain silent.

findings.trigger: Recipient changed while openModal awaited; unconditional handedOff retained obsolete ready proof.
findings.resolution: Recheck state after modal opening, close owned obsolete modal and clear parameters while serialized ownership is retained.

findings.trigger: SDK openModal awaits discovery and can auto-connect embedded wallet before returning; status could otherwise verify against an edited recipient during pending preparation.
findings.resolution: tcHandleWallet tests preparation state and availability before incrementing generation; obsolete pending preparation cannot start verification.

assessment: Preparation token serializes requests and binds exact existing recipient state, route and SDK availability; duplicate calls and calls during verification do not begin preparation. Rechecks follow initialization, JSON, disconnect and modal-opening completion.

Payload HTTP success and bounded nonempty string are required; 8-second abort covers response body and late completion. Failure/stale cleanup only acts for owned token and restores button; successful current modal handoff retains proof.

Own null disconnect may rebind only during awaited disconnect with unchanged original state. Recipient edits and replacement wallet statuses cannot rebind the old attempt; failed/still-connected disconnect prevents modal opening.
Actual vendored SDK and production copy matched by SHA; async discovery and embedded fire-and-forget behavior documented in sdk-review.json and SDK pinned as an additional read-only live input.
No active-preparation blockers remain in reviewed candidate. Lifecycle after preparation retirement is explicitly a separate open item, not covered by this PASS.
Only declaration, tcHandleWallet preamble and tcConnect changed; recipient response application, submit payloads, shared review, SDK bundle and backend unchanged.
Read-only production preflight passed with 57 live inputs and 4 unchanged services. Seventeen local scope/drift/atomic apply/reconcile/rollback checks passed.

next_boundary.description: After tcPreparation is cleared, a delayed SDK connection status can still be accepted against the current recipient. SDK closeModal only closes UI and does not cancel a pending embedded connection. Requires persistent connection-intent ownership across preparation retirement; current slice does not claim to suppress all later stale callbacks.
